title: MedScript OPD - Offline-First Outpatient Prescription & Electronic Medical Records (EMR) System
description: MedScript OPD is a sovereign, offline-first Electronic Medical Records (EMR) and clinical prescription system designed for independent physicians and outpatient clinics. It features cryptographic prescription integrity sealing, real-time drug-drug interaction surveillance, ICD-10 diagnostic coding, role-based clinical access control, and FHIR R4 health data interoperability. Built for complete data sovereignty — patient records never leave the clinic premises.
